effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] By deleting 1 of your Digimon, delete 2 of your opponent's Digimon with 5000 DP or less.
[On Deletion] You may play 1 purple or red level 3 Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [On Deletion] You may play 1 red or purple level 3 Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.
